name: Aldarra Golf Club

dtm.source: USGS 3DEP elevation service (3DEPElevation ImageServer exportImage, 1 m, EPSG:32610, box x 577100-579800 / y 5269500-5272100); the 1 m DEM under the course is WA_KingCounty_2021_B21 (tile x57y528, flown 2021-04-01 to 2021-09-07, published 2023-03-03, per the service's identify); fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-aldarra, usgs_dem_m.tif)

laz.source: USGS Lidar Point Cloud WA_KingCounty_2021_B21 (WA_KingCo_1_2021 and WA_KingCo_2_2021), tiles from rockyweb.usgs.gov fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-aldarra), each clipped to the world + 100 m by intake.py laz --keep-evlrs; NAD83(2011) / Washington North (US ft), NAVD88 US ft; class 1 (unclassified: vegetation and structures), no vegetation classes
laz.label: 2021 USGS King County lidar

ortho.source: USDA NAIP from the USGS National Map NAIP ImageServer (exportImage, about 0.6 m, EPSG:32610), four JPEG exports resampled onto one 0.6 m grid by make_ortho.py; fetched by the GitHub Actions workflow 2026-11-13 (release data-aldarra)

world.note: OSM course boundary (way 255315612, 2,071 x 2,022 m in EPSG:32610) + 120 m of scenery, rounded out to whole 256 m chunks and centred. Over the 2,048 m guideline both ways (COURSE_BUILD.md 6.1).

scorecard_source: GolfPass, Aldarra Golf Club scorecard (read 2026-11-13): Aldarra (the back set) 6,926 yd per hole (GolfPass's tee table says 6,885 and rates it 74.0/147; Offcourse rates 6,926 at 74.9/151), men's par and handicap rows; Championship, Champ/Member, Member, Member/Club, Club, Club/Forward and Forward in scorecard.csv, not built. Unverified (third party; private club, card not online). OSM tags hole 11 par 4; the card's par 5 is used.
attribution: Elevation and trees: U.S. Geological Survey 3D Elevation Program (King County 2021 lidar)
Imagery check: USDA National Agriculture Imagery Program (NAIP)
